backend/main.mo: Motoko canister implementing access-controlled user profiles, cutoff data queries, and admin-only CSV import, with types and simple lead storage.
feature_evidence.json: Feature-evidence manifest linking a deployment retry feature to its related frontend files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the roles and behavior of multiple frontend components, utilities, pages, and config files.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind base setup defining OKLCH theme variables for light/dark modes and applying shared background and border styles.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point mounting the React app and loading main.tsx with the updated page title.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Top-level React component handling simple page routing within an ErrorBoundary and shared site layout.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminLeadE: Admin-only UI card that checks authorization, fetches exported lead data from the backend, and offers copy/download options with error handling.
frontend/src/components/deployment/GoLiv: Component showing a connection-failure notice with troubleshooting tips and a retry button for failed backend initialization.
frontend/src/components/ErrorBoundary.ts: React error boundary that displays a detailed fallback card with error info and a reload option when runtime errors occur.
frontend/src/components/layout/SiteLayou: Provides the main site layout with header navigation, page content wrapper, and footer.
frontend/src/components/lead-capture/Lea: Modal form that validates and submits lead information including name, mobile, WhatsApp, and optional email.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to Internet Identity, refetching dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useActorWithRetry.ts: Wraps useActor with timeout detection and a retry mechanism that reloads the page if initialization stalls.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides context and helpers for Internet Identity login, state management, and identity persistence.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind setup and theme variables defining light and dark color schemes with utility overrides.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Initializes React app with QueryClient and InternetIdentityProvider and mounts it to the DOM.
frontend/src/pages/ContactSupportPage.ts: Displays support information, contact guidelines, and common issue tips using styled UI components.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Landing page with banner, hero section, feature cards, and navigation button to the predictor.
frontend/src/pages/HowItWorksPage.tsx: Explains the predictor steps using cards, covering inputs, rank calculation, and cutoff matching.
frontend/src/pages/MhtCetPredictorFormPa: Form page handling percentile inputs, preferences, lead capture, CSV cutoff uploads, and backend prediction requests.
frontend/src/pages/PredictorPage.tsx: Wrapper page showing intro text, a cutoff data alert, and the main predictor form.
frontend/src/utils/predictorDefaults.ts: Defines default backend parameters, mainly defaulting candidature to Maharashtra.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, persisting, and clearing URL and session parameters.
frontend/src/utils/validation/whatsapp.t: Validates and normalizes Indian WhatsApp phone numbers with basic rules.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending themes, colors, fonts, and animations for the project.
project_state.json: Project metadata tracking schema, features, known issues, and production go-live retry context.
